metadata.name: xtomb
metadata.description: Solana xTOMB fork: Genesis passes, Fire Tax exits, xBOND, lazy-epoch Masonry

accounts.name: payin_mint
docs: Mutable: an xTOMB pay-in burns against this mint.

accounts.name: payin_vault
docs: created (or validated) manually in the instruction.

accounts.name: asset
docs: Fresh keypair: the new Metaplex Core asset (the soulbound NFT).

accounts.name: rewards_vault
docs: Rewards vault paying this pool: the Genesis rewards vault for
standard/LP/Ultra pools, the Masonry vault for the Masonry pool.
Must be xTOMB and owned by the config PDA.

accounts.name: xtomb_mint
docs: xTOMB mint — needed to burn the Genesis claim Fire Tax.

accounts.name: owner
docs: (manual) or any keeper (keeper compound, Pro/Ultra only).

accounts.name: xtomb_mint
docs: Anchor `init` is deliberately NOT used here: nine `init` accounts
blow the 4KB BPF stack in `try_accounts` (Access violation in
stack frame 3). Creation is done explicitly in the handler.

docs: created by this instruction.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Caller is not the admin

errors.name: NotOracle
errors.msg: Caller is not the oracle authority or admin

errors.name: Maintenance
errors.msg: Program is in maintenance mode

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: Invalid pass tier (must be 1 Genesis, 2 Pro, or 3 Ultra)

errors.name: PassAlreadyOwned
errors.msg: Wallet already owns a pass (one per wallet)

errors.name: NoPass
errors.msg: No pass found for this wallet

errors.name: NotAnUpgrade
errors.msg: Upgrade must move to a higher tier

errors.name: PassSalesClosed
errors.msg: Pass purchases and upgrades are closed (Genesis ended)

errors.name: GenesisNotStarted
errors.msg: Genesis has not started yet (Ultra pre-stake opens T-24h)

errors.name: GenesisEnded
errors.msg: Genesis has ended; deposits and compounds are closed

errors.name: LpNotOpen
errors.msg: LP staking opens on Day 2 (T+24h)

errors.name: PoolInactive
errors.msg: Pool is not active

errors.name: WrongPoolKind
errors.msg: Pool kind does not match this operation

errors.name: WrongPoolId
errors.msg: Pool id does not match its canonical kind (1 standard, 2 LP, 3 ultra, 4 masonry, 10+ farm)

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientStake
errors.msg: Insufficient staked balance

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient token balance

errors.name: CompoundTooSoon
errors.msg: Compound or claim too soon: the 3h per-user-per-pool cap has not elapsed

errors.name: OracleStale
errors.msg: Oracle data is stale (older than 30 min); withdrawals fail closed, buys stay available

errors.name: BondBuyClosed
errors.msg: TWAP is not below $1.00; xBOND buys are closed

errors.name: BondRedeemClosed
errors.msg: TWAP is not above $1.00; xBOND redemptions are closed

errors.name: BondMaxOutstanding
errors.msg: xBOND purchase would exceed the configured max outstanding

errors.name: Epoch0NotTriggered
errors.msg: Epoch 0 has not been triggered by the admin yet

errors.name: EpochNotDue
errors.msg: No epoch is due yet

errors.name: MintsAlreadyCreated
errors.msg: Mints have already been created

errors.name: BadFeeSplit
errors.msg: Operational fee split must sum to 10000 bps

errors.name: InsufficientRewards
errors.msg: Rewards vault holds too little to pay this claim

errors.name: UltraAlreadyStaked
errors.msg: Ultra pass is already staked as an NFT position

errors.name: RequiresUltraPass
errors.msg: Ultra NFT staking requires the Ultra pass

errors.name: RequiresKeeperTier
errors.msg: Keeper compounding requires a Pro or Ultra pass

errors.name: NothingToCompound
errors.msg: No liquid rewards to compound

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing accrued to claim

errors.name: BuybackGuard
errors.msg: TWAP guard rejected the buyback (requires fresh TWAP at or below $1.01)

errors.name: NotBot
errors.msg: Caller is not the trading-bot wallet or admin

errors.name: BadTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account mint or owner does not match the config

errors.name: BadVaultPda
errors.msg: Vault account is not the expected program-derived address

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: BadFireTaxConfig
errors.msg: Invalid Fire Tax config (cap above the 12% ceiling, a baseline or resting rate above the cap, or a recovery window out of range)

errors.name: BondPayinRejected
errors.msg: Bond pay-in asset is not accepted (pay with USDC, wrapped SOL, or xTOMB)

errors.name: BondSolPriceMissing
errors.msg: No SOL price has been posted; SOL bond pay-ins are unavailable

errors.name: BondLpMintNotSet
errors.msg: Bond LP mint is not registered yet (admin must call set_bond_config first)

errors.name: BadBondConfig
errors.msg: Invalid bond config (premium above 100%, or the LP mint is locked by existing backing)

errors.name: BadPassConfig
errors.msg: Invalid pass config (a price of zero, or a deposit fee above 1000 bps)

fields.name: queued_redeem
docs: Redemptions queued when the expansion allowance was exhausted
(xBOND stays in the user's wallet until settled; no partial fill).

fields.name: genesis_reward_budget
docs: Prefunded Genesis reward budget (base units of xTOMB).

fields.name: genesis_rewards_distributed
docs: xTOMB already settled out of the Genesis budget (accounting).

fields.name: genesis_emission_per_sec
docs: Genesis emission rate, base units of xTOMB per second.

fields.name: farm_emission_per_sec
docs: Farm emission rate, base units of xSHARE per second (25,641 / 365d).

fields.name: oracle_twap_e6
docs: Latest oracle TWAP, USDC e6 (1_000_000 = $1.00).

fields.name: circulating_xtomb
docs: Minted xTOMB supply tracked by the program (mint - burn).

fields.name: expansion_allowance
docs: xTOMB mint budget available for bond redemptions.

fields.name: treasury_bps
docs: Operational fee split (bps, must sum to 10_000).

fields.name: fee_display_name
docs: Display name of the exit fee ("Fire Tax"); "Fire Hose" is the
config-comment alternative Jess floated.

fields.name: xshare_tax_pending_burn
docs: xSHARE Fire Tax collected while in Critical Defense, earmarked for
buy-and-burn conversion (conversion itself is off-chain/bot work).

fields.name: fire_tax_base_xtomb_bps
docs: xTOMB withdrawal Fire Tax baseline at/above peg, bps (default 300).

fields.name: fire_tax_base_xshare_bps
docs: xSHARE withdrawal Fire Tax baseline at/above peg, bps (default 600).

fields.name: fire_tax_cap_bps
docs: Fire Tax cap for both tokens, bps (default 1200; never above the
1200 hard ceiling — the setter validates).

fields.name: fire_tax_rest_bps
docs: Recovery floor resting rate for both tokens, bps (default 300).

fields.name: fire_tax_recovery_secs
docs: Recovery floor decay window, seconds (default 25_200 = 7h).

fields.name: fire_tax_zeroed
docs: Healthy override: while true, both withdrawal Fire Taxes are 0.

fields.name: bond_premium_bps
docs: Premium credited on native-token / USDC bond pay-ins, bps of
pay-in value (default 1000 = 10%). Set via set_bond_config.

fields.name: bond_lp_mint
docs: The xTOMB LP mint bonds are denominated in. Redemption pays LP
of this mint out of the bond backing vault. Set (once the LP
exists) via set_bond_config, which also creates the vault.

fields.name: bond_backing_lp
docs: LP the operator has deposited into the bond backing vault via
deposit_bond_backing. Redemption entitlements are computed
against this counter (capped by the vault's real balance).

fields.name: sol_price_e6
docs: Oracle-posted SOL price, USD e6 per whole SOL (0 = unset).
Prices the wrapped-SOL bond pay-in leg; posted with
set_sol_price by the oracle authority or admin.

fields.name: sol_price_ts
docs: Timestamp of the last SOL price post (freshness-gated like
the TWAP: SOL pay-ins fail closed on a stale price).

fields.name: bond_xtomb_premium_bps
docs: Premium credited on xTOMB bond pay-ins, bps of pay-in value
(default 300 = 3%; a stored 0 resolves to the compiled
default, same convention as bond_premium_bps). xTOMB
pay-ins BURN like a classic bond (Jess 2026-11-08) instead
of custoding in the pay-in vault. Set via
set_bond_xtomb_premium. Appended 2026-11-08 (tail-append,
same spare-capacity pattern).

fields.name: pass_price_genesis_usdc
docs: Genesis pass price, whole USDC (default 50).

fields.name: pass_price_pro_usdc
docs: Pro pass price, whole USDC (default 100).

fields.name: pass_price_ultra_usdc
docs: Ultra pass price, whole USDC (default 300).

fields.name: pass_deposit_fee_genesis_bps
docs: Standard-pool deposit fee for Genesis pass holders, bps
(default 200 = 2%).

fields.name: pass_deposit_fee_pro_bps
docs: Standard-pool deposit fee for Pro pass holders, bps
(default 100 = 1%).

fields.name: pass_deposit_fee_ultra_bps
docs: Standard-pool deposit fee for Ultra pass holders, bps
(default 0).

fields.name: tier
docs: 1 = Genesis, 2 = Pro, 3 = Ultra.

fields.name: asset
docs: Metaplex Core asset (soulbound NFT) for this pass.

fields.name: ultra_staked
docs: True while the Ultra NFT itself is staked in Genesis.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 standard, 1 LP, 2 farm, 3 masonry, 4 ultra-NFT.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA-owned token vault holding staked principal.

fields.name: acc_per_share
docs: Accumulated xTOMB (or xSHARE for farm pools) per staked unit, x ACC_SCALE.

fields.name: weight_bps
docs: Farm pool weight in bps of the farm emission rate (farm pools only).

fields.name: amount
docs: Staked principal (base units). Ultra-NFT positions hold 1 pseudo-unit.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Reward debt, TOKEN-denominated: `amount * acc_per_share /
ACC_SCALE` at the last settle. Pending rewards are the
position's current token entitlement minus this debt — the
debt is NOT a per-share quantity.

fields.name: accrued_liquid
docs: Settled rewards awaiting claim: liquid half (xTOMB, or xSHARE on
farm positions).

fields.name: accrued_vested
docs: Settled rewards awaiting vesting (xTOMB, Genesis pools only).

fields.name: vesting_total
docs: Total vested rewards in the current tranche (base units).

fields.name: vesting_claimed_amount
docs: Base units of the tranche already released.

fields.name: vesting_claimed_installments
docs: Installments already released (0..16).

fields.name: vesting_next_ts
docs: Unix time the next vesting installment opens.

fields.name: last_cooldown_ts
docs: Shared 3h claim+compound clock (last claim or compound, 0 = never).
